statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered
The service was to characterize the frequency and duration of symptomatic events
The service was to correlate cardiac rhythm with reported giddiness and palpitations
The diagnoses documented are R00.2 and R42
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial reason code is CO-197
